title: August Wünsche – Midraschim: German translations
description: Thirteen historical German Midrash translations by August Wünsche, including the Mechiltha with Jakob Winter: the ten Midrash Rabbah works on the Torah and Five Megillot, Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, Midrash Shmuel and Mechiltha. Ten editions are exported from Safran; the Wünsche editions of Bereshit, Shemot and Vayikra Rabbah come from the public Sefaria export. 5,897 nonempty segments, preserved footnotes, edition metadata, source-specific rights notices, SHA-256 provenance and validation scripts. Known omissions of digital editions are documented. CC BY 4.0 applies to new documentation and editorial preparation; upstream source notices and separate MIT script terms remain applicable.
